reveal_en: The starlight reaching us tonight began its journey eons ago. We gaze not at what is, but a luminous whisper from the universe's distant past.
reveal_zh: 今夜星光，亿万年前已启程。我们凝视的，是宇宙远古的回响。
meaning_en: To look up is to travel through time. Each twinkling point connects us to the universe's deep memory, reminding us of our place in an unfolding cosmic story, both fleeting and eternal.
meaning_zh: 仰望即是穿越时空。每颗星光连接着宇宙深处的记忆，提醒我们，在浩瀚的宇宙史诗中，我们的存在既短暂又永恒。

visual.color: Deep navy, ethereal violet, celestial gold
visual.motion: Slow, gentle drift of luminous particles, subtle stellar pulse
